text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I handed the arrived fan letters to Grass 
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, this person... wrote me another 
letter, did they?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just as usual, it opens with "Dear Sir" 
and closes with "Sincerely yours." Fufu...
choice_data_list:
Did you find an intriguing fan letter or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is rather formal for a fan letter, 
but it's a letter that leaves a deep 
impression on the heart.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The skillfully and meticulously written 
characters grew more proficient day by 
day...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not satisfied with just that, lately he's 
even been incorporating seasonal words and 
composing entire haikus.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Knowing my tastes and preferences, you 
must have penned every single stroke with 
care.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: A deep warmth wells up within my chest...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could feel the fan's earnest desire to 
make Grass Wonder happy as if it were my 
own.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not just this person, but also someone who 
introduces Japanese culture and regional 
customs...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I receive such letters sent to me 
from all across the country, I—
choice_data_list:
It makes you want to give it your all, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed~ It makes me want to lose even 
less—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A quiet fighting spirit ignites in Grass 
Wonder's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall spare no effort and go through 
fire and water for your sake, so I look 
forward to working with you going forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's motivation seemed to rise 
with the support from her fans.
